question: What decision currently governs elasticsearch multi value enforcement after the explicit revert? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: The currently active decision is elastic/elasticsearch#147360, which reverted the enforcement of single values when multi_value is no, supported by authority evidence at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/147360.
Decision elastic/elasticsearch#147360 was implemented to revert PR #147071 in order to unblock CI after test failures.
Decision elastic/elasticsearch#147071 originally attempted to enforce single values for fields configured with multi_value=no, but it is reverted and no longer active.
